description: How a live stream is doing ON YOUTUBE: watch URL, broadcast status, concurrent viewers, views and likes. Only meaningful while the stream is live to a YouTube channel connected through Streamloop — a custom RTMP destination reports nothing here, since those numbers live with that platform. Returns the stream as node: id, name and youtubeLiveStats (watchUrl, lifecycle, concurrentViewers, totalViews, likeCount, fetchedAt, and mirrorStatus / mirrorLastError for the YouTube broadcast sync); youtubeLiveStats is null when there is no connected YouTube broadcast. For whether Streamloop itself considers the stream healthy, read state from get_stream.

id.description: Stream id (stream_...), from list_streams. Ask about a stream that is live to a connected YouTube channel.

name: get_stream_live_stats

youtubeLiveStats.description: watchUrl, lifecycle, concurrentViewers, totalViews, likeCount, fetchedAt, mirrorStatus, mirrorLastError.

node.description: The stream; null when no stream has that id.
